messages:
Samir Patel: starting rollout thread for Ironwood private cluster -> targeted cutover: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. plan: pin runtime to release v2.3.1, canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m, full traffic after metrics look good. needs: KMS rotation check, cert expiry, and SRE ack on rollback thresholds.
Maya Chen: ack on timing, 02:00 UTC is fine for their TZ. can we avoid KMS rotation during the window? last rotation clashed last month.
Leo Ortiz: we need the cert sanity check too — ironwood's tenant cert renews 2026-04-01 23:30 UTC per certbot logs. recommend moving cutover to 03:00 unless cert is preloaded.
Samir Patel: good catch. I'll coordinate with Ironwood to pre-load certs. if they can't, we'll shift to 03:00. KMS: @Kira - Security can you confirm no rotation scheduled 03:00-04:30 UTC?
Kira - Security: confirming: no org-wide KMS rotations scheduled in that window. Ironwood may have customer-managed KMS; we need their ack. I emailed their infra lead.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: ironwood-private/v2.3.1 -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z, canary=5% (30m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% (manual). Change ID: cb-ironwood-2965.
Ben (sre): SRE checklist: healthcheck endpoints, latency p50/p95 alerting enabled, autoscale set to reserved slice,+20% headroom. Rollback triggers proposed: error rate >2% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency regression >350ms over baseline for 5m. Thoughts?
Maya Chen: those rollback thresholds look reasonable. add token-cost spike watch too (cost spike >40% vs baseline for 15m) — we've seen evictions cause reroutes and cost spikes.
Samir Patel: updated: add cost spike trigger. Also pin model binary digest in the rollout config: model_digest: sha256:4f8a2b... (so we don't accidentally pull a hotfix).
Leo Ortiz: can we set an automatic fallback to the previous variant (v2.2.9-quant) on rollback? That was helpful in prior cutovers.
Ben (sre): yes, we'll enable automatic fallback to v2.2.9-quant for the first rollback attempt, then manual rollback to earlier snapshot if issues persist. document in runbook.
Maya Chen: runbook snippet (for ops):
```
- deploybot start cb-ironwood-2965 --stage canary
- monitor p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost metrics in console -> ironwood/cb-2965
- if trigger -> deploybot rollback cb-ironwood-2965 --target v2.2.9-quant
- if continued issues -> escalate to SRE + PM, pause traffic, open incident.
```
Samir Patel: logging an explicit approval list: @Maya Chen (PM), @Ben (sre) (SRE), @Leo Ortiz (Oncall), @Kira - Security. please reply with :thumbsup: or :no_entry: for objections.
Kira - Security: :thumbsup: KMS clear, MFA confirmed for Ironwood infra lead.
Ben (sre): :thumbsup: SRE ack, autoscale & alerts configured.
Leo Ortiz: :thumbsup: oncall ack. I'll be available during the window.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: PM approves, I coordinated the cert preload with the customer.
Samir Patel: thanks all. I'll update the change ticket with runbook, digests, and link to the deploybot plan. final step: @deploybot please add a post-deploy smoke check step to validate /health and a sample end-to-end conversation for 10 requests.
deploybot: Post-deploy smoke checks appended to change cb-ironwood-2965: /health (3x 5s apart) + e2e-sample (10 requests) -> requires manual confirmation to mark done.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: declare incident channel #ironwood-cutover if rollback occurs. automatic pager will be triggered on configured SLO breaches.
Samir Patel: thread closed for now. I'll ping here 1h before the window with final go/no-go.
